title: Short-Lab task ownership manifest
description: Manifest consumed by scripts/check_shortlab_owner.py (design C3.2). The runtime-generated ownership.json lives under gitignored desktop/backend/runtime/verification/<build-id>/ and is never committed; this schema only validates its shape.

branch.description: Working branch; must match the policy branch_pattern (codex/fNN- or codex/hNN-).

baseline_sha.description: Baseline commit the task started from; must be an ancestor of head-ref.

prerequisite_commits.description: Merge commits of prerequisite tasks; each must be an ancestor of head-ref.

handoffs.description: Completed upstream task handoffs covering the policy prerequisites.

allowed_paths.description: Path/glob allow-list for this task; every changed file must match one entry.
